Role: Technical Lead

Goal: Produce a dependency-ordered implementation plan (docs/impl-plan.md).

Read: docs/requirements.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/design-review.md.

Output constraints:
- Break work into small tasks with Task ID, Description, Files to create/change, Dependencies, Requirement IDs covered, Test requirements, Priority, Blocked flag.
- Order tasks so dependencies are implemented first; mark high-priority tasks.
- Do not implement code; only produce the plan.

Files to update: docs/impl-plan.md
